modalities.value: GUI screenshots as input; keyboard and mouse actions as output

source.quote: directly perceives the screenshot, applies reasoning processes, and generates valid actions autonomously.

reasoningModes.value: System-1 (direct action, no CoT) and System-2 (deliberate thinking / reasoning steps before action)

source.quote:
System-1 reasoning refers
to the model directly producing actions without chain-of-thought, while system-2 reasoning involves a more
deliberate thinking process where the model generates reasoning steps before selecting
developed three model variants: UI-TARS-2B, UI-TARS-7B and UI-TARS-72B.

architecture.value: Continual training on Qwen-2-VL VLM backbone (2B / 7B / 72B)

source.quote:
use the same VLM backbone, Qwen-2-VL (Wang et al., 2024c), and adopt a three-phase training
process.

trainingData.value: About 50B tokens of GUI perception, grounding, action-trace, and reflection data (three-phase training)

source.quote: approximately 50B tokens. Each phase progressively incorporates higher-quality data to enhance the model’s

findings.text: No dedicated safety, alignment, refusal, jailbreak, bias, or dangerous-capability evaluation section; the paper is a graphical user interface (GUI)-agent capability report.

source.quote:
These experiments are designed to assess the
models’ capabilities in three critical dimensions: perception, grounding, and agent capabilities.

findings.text: With Best-of-1 sampling, system-2 (with thought) can invent non-existent objects or wrong inferences and raise hallucination or action-failure risk versus system-1.

source.quote:
introduce irrelevant or incorrect reasoning steps—such as referring to non-existent objects or making erroneous
inferences—which increases the risk of hallucinations or failure to generate the correct action.

findings.text: Dense-caption training aims to minimize hallucinations, but that is a training objective, not a measured model safety result.

source.quote: minimizing hallucinations. The goal of dense captioning is to provide a comprehensive, detailed description

notes: GUI-agent technical report (arXiv:2501.12326), not a system card. No safety/alignment/jailbreak/toxicity/honesty/dangerous-capability benchmarks—evalResults left empty. Only safety-adjacent claim: system-2 Bo1 can increase hallucination risk (topic hallucination covered). Dense-caption “minimizing hallucinations” and DOM “privacy concerns” are training/design notes, not topic coverage. Skipped all capability evals (pilot SAFETY ONLY): VisualWebBench, WebSRC, ScreenQA-short, ScreenSpot / ScreenSpot Pro / ScreenSpot v2, Mind2Web, AndroidControl, GUI Odyssey, OSWorld, AndroidWorld, and Figure 8 system-1/2 BoN curves (no readable numeric table in text for that figure). 32k sequence length is an agent memory/token-budget example, not a stated inference context window. Open-sourced at GitHub with no license name. arXiv 21 Jan 2025 is publication, not a model release date. Seed-linked ByteDance-Seed/UI-TARS-1.5-7B is not named in this report (1.5 is later)—left out of covers; covered UI-TARS-2B/7B/72B and SFT/DPO variants named in the text, mapping UI-TARS-7B-DPO and UI-TARS-72B-DPO to seed checkpoints.
